mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS capability_id, c.capability_code, c.capability_name, c.description, v.source_type, v.source_key, v.source_version, v.behavior, v.version, v.input_schema, v.output_schema, v.policy_snapshot, g.field_policy, v.risk_level, v.required_actor_type FROM ai_capability_grant g INNER JOIN ai_capability c ON c.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND c.id = g.capability_id AND c.del_flag = 0 AND c.enabled = 1 AND c.publish_status = 'PUBLISHED' AND c.risk_level <> 'HIGH' INNER JOIN ai_capability_client cli ON cli.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND cli.id = g.client_id AND cli.del_flag = 0 AND cli.status = 'ENABLED' AND (cli.expires_at IS NULL OR cli.expires_at > NOW()) INNER JOIN ai_capability_version v ON v.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND v.capability_id = c.id AND v.del_flag = 0 AND v.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND v.risk_level = c.risk_level AND v.source_type = c.source_type AND v.behavior = c.behavior AND v.required_actor_type = c.required_actor_type AND v.version = CASE WHEN g.version_strategy = 'FOLLOW_MAJOR' AND CASE WHEN POSITION('.' IN COALESCE(c.current_version, '')) > 0 THEN SUBSTRING(c.current_version FROM 1 FOR POSITION('.' IN c.current_version) - 1) ELSE COALESCE(c.current_version, '') END = CASE WHEN POSITION('.' IN COALESCE(g.fixed_version, '')) > 0 THEN SUBSTRING(g.fixed_version FROM 1 FOR POSITION('.' IN g.fixed_version) - 1) ELSE COALESCE(g.fixed_version, '') END THEN c.current_version ELSE g.fixed_version END WHERE g.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND g.client_id = #{clientId} AND g.del_flag = 0 AND g.status = 'ENABLED' AND (g.expires_at IS NULL OR g.expires_at > NOW()) AND c.capability_code = #{capabilityCode} LIMIT 1
